title: Zarr v2 array metadata (.zarray)
description: A Zarr v2 array metadata document. See https://zarr-specs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/v2/v2.0.html

ZarrV2CodecMetadata.description:
A numcodecs configuration dict, used as a v2 compressor or filter.

The required `id` field names the codec; codec-specific parameters
(e.g. `cname`, `clevel` for blosc) appear as extra fields.

See the "compressor" and "filters" sections of
https://zarr-specs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/v2/v2.0.html
ZarrV2CodecMetadata.title: ZarrV2CodecMetadata

zarr_format.title: Zarr Format
zarr_format.description: The Zarr format version. Always the integer 2.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: The dimensions of the array: one non-negative integer per axis.

chunks.title: Chunks
chunks.description: The chunk dimensions: one non-negative integer per axis, with the same number of dimensions as shape.

dtype.description: The numpy-style data type, e.g. "<f8" (little-endian float64), or a list of field records for structured dtypes.

compressor.description: The primary compressor: a numcodecs configuration object with a string "id", or null for no compression.

fill_value.description: The value used for unwritten chunks.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: A list of numcodecs filter configurations applied before the compressor, or null for none. An empty list is not permitted.

dimension_separator.title: Dimension Separator
dimension_separator.description: The chunk-key separator: "." (default, flat keys like 0.0) or "/" (nested directories).

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: User attributes. On disk these live in the sibling .zattrs file, NOT in .zarray; this key is tolerated here for merged representations.
